metadata.question: Was the number of fire detections in Pantanal, Brazil on June 11, 2024, greater than the number detected in any June from 2000 to 2023, as observed with MODIS Aqua?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Aqua fire detections - "MODIS/006/MYD14A1" (daily fire mask product) - Date: June 11, 2024 vs. all days in June for years 2000-2023 - Location: Pantanal, Brazil - need to define geometry for this region - Note: MODIS Aqua started in July 2002, so 2000-2001 will have no data 2. Masking strategy: - This is about fire detections, so I need the FireMask band - FireMask values: 7-9 are fire pixels (7=low, 8=nominal, 9=high confidence) - Count pixels where FireMask >= 7 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If June 11, 2024 has 0 fire pixels, that's a valid result (answer B) - C1: If no images found for 2024 date - C2: If images exist but region has no valid pixels (unlikely for fire product over large area) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - A: If 2024 count > max of any June day 2000-2023 - B: Otherwise ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Define Pantanal geometry (approximate bounding box) pantanal = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-58.5, -21.5], [-58.5, -15.5], [-55.0, -15.5], [-55.0, -21.5], [-58.5, -21.5]] ]) # 2. Get MODIS Aqua fire data for June 11, 2024 date_2024 = '2024-06-11' col_2024 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD14A1') \ .filterDate(date_2024, '2024-06-12') \ .filterBounds(pantanal) print(f"Images on {date_2024}: {col_2024.size().getInfo()}") if col_2024.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No MODIS Aqua data for June 11, 2024") print("C1") else: # Count fire pixels for 2024 img_2024 = col_2024.first() fire_mask_2024 = img_2024.select('FireMask').gte(7) count_2024 = fire_mask_2024.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=pantanal, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('FireMask').getInfo() print(f"Fire pixels on {date_2024}: {count_2024}") if count_2024 is None: print("Calculation failed for 2024") print("C3") else: # 3. data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define Pantanal geometry (approximate bounding box)
pantanal = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[-58.5, -21.5], [-58.5, -15.5], [-55.0, -15.5], [-55.0, -21.5], [-58.5, -21.5]]
])

# 2. Get MODIS Aqua fire data for June 11, 2024
date_2024 = '2024-06-11'
col_2024 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD14A1') \
    .filterDate(date_2024, '2024-06-12') \
    .filterBounds(pantanal)

print(f"Images on {date_2024}: {col_2024.size().getInfo()}")

if col_2024.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No MODIS Aqua data for June 11, 2024")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Count fire pixels for 2024
    img_2024 = col_2024.first()
    fire_mask_2024 = img_2024.select('FireMask').gte(7)
    
    count_2024 = fire_mask_2024.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=pantanal,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('FireMask').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Fire pixels on {date_2024}: {count_2024}")
    
    if count_2024 is None:
        print("Calculation failed for 2024")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # 3. Get historical June data (2000-2023)
        # Note: MODIS Aqua started July 2002, so 2000-2002 June will be empty
        max_historical = 0
        
        for year in range(2000, 2024):
            col_year = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD14A1') \
                .filterDate(f'{year}-06-01', f'{year}-07-01') \
                .filterBounds(pantanal)
            
            size = col_year.size().getInfo()
            
            if size > 0:
                # Count fires for each day in June and find max
                def count_fires(img):
                    fire_mask = img.select('FireMask').gte(7)
                    count = fire_mask.reduceRegion(
                        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                        geometry=pantanal,
                        scale=1000,
                        maxPixels=1e9
                    ).get('FireMask')
                    return img.set('fire_count', count)
                
                col_with_counts = col_year.map(count_fires)
                year_max = col_with_counts.aggregate_max('fire_count').getInfo()
                
                if year_max is not None and year_max > max_historical:
                    max_historical = year_max
                
                print(f"{year} June: {size} imgs, max fires: {year_max}")
        
        print(f"\nMax historical (2000-2023): {max_historical}")
        print(f"June 11, 2024: {count_2024}")
        
        if count_2024 > max_historical:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
